description.p: Argon is an open-source desktop web browser built on LibreWolf and Mozilla's Gecko engine, with flexible tab layouts, privacy-focused defaults, and no first-party telemetry.

ul.li: Switch between horizontal tabs and a collapsible vertical sidebar without restarting.
Keep browsing organized in container-isolated workspaces with per-workspace pinned tabs and a command palette.
Block trackers and page clutter with a built-in content blocker and GhostPrint anti-fingerprinting.
Customize surfaces, accent colors, UI density, and corner radius, and run Manifest V3 extensions through a built-in compatibility bridge.

description.p: Initial stable release of Argon Browser for Linux:

ul.li: Customizable Obsidian and Ivory interface with horizontal and vertical tab layouts.
Container-isolated workspaces, pinned per-workspace tabs, and configurable shortcuts.
Integrated uBlock Origin filtering core and GhostPrint anti-fingerprinting defaults.
First-run setup wizard, default privacy configuration, and Manifest V3 extension compatibility bridge.
